name: observations
title: Observations
description: Table with environmental observations derived from media. An observation is an interpreted claim about a condition, process, or event — not a taxon record. Quantitative facts belong in `measurements`. Wildlife/taxon observations belong in Camtrap DP, not here.

fields.name: deploymentID
fields.description: Identifier of the deployment the observation belongs to. Foreign key to `deployments.deploymentID`.

fields.name: mediaID
fields.description: Identifier of the media file that was classified. Required when `observationLevel` is `media`. Foreign key to `media.mediaID`.

fields.name: eventID
fields.description: Identifier of a multi-file event (e.g. a repeat-photo pair, a dive transect, or a storm sequence).

fields.name: eventStart
fields.description: Date and time at which the observed event or classification window started. ISO 8601 with timezone designator.

fields.name: eventEnd
fields.description: Date and time at which the observed event or classification window ended. For a single still frame this equals `eventStart`.

fields.name: observationLevel
fields.description: `media` for a classification tied to one file. `event` for a classification over a set of files or a visit.

fields.name: observationType
fields.description: Domain of the environmental observation. This is the abiotic analogue of Camtrap DP `observationType=animal`. Do not use this table for taxon records.

fields.name: condition
fields.description: Short qualitative label for what was observed (e.g. algal bloom, canopy loss, smog, glacier retreat). Controlled values may be added by a profile. Quantitative values go in `measurements`.

fields.name: bboxX
fields.description: Horizontal position of the top-left corner of a bounding box, relative to media width (`0`–`1`).

fields.name: bboxY
fields.description: Vertical position of the top-left corner of a bounding box, relative to media height (`0`–`1`).

fields.name: bboxWidth
fields.description: Bounding box width relative to media width.

fields.name: bboxHeight
fields.description: Bounding box height relative to media height.

fields.name: classificationMethod
fields.description: Method used to classify the observation.

fields.name: classifiedBy
fields.description: Person, organization, or model that classified the observation.

fields.name: classificationTimestamp
fields.description: Date and time of the classification. ISO 8601 with timezone designator.

fields.name: observationTags
fields.description: Tags associated with the observation. Pipe-separated, optionally `key:value` pairs.

fields.name: observationComments
fields.description: Comments or notes about the observation.
fields.example: Visible surface scum and discoloration in nearshore water.
